text: Capgemini SE is a listed company whose share capital is widely held: its 2024 Universal Registration Document counts it among 'companies with widely-held share capital'.
short: Capgemini SE is listed, with widely-held share capital.

source.name: Capgemini: 2024 Universal Registration Document, chapter 2 (Corporate governance, PDF)
source.quote: In companies with widely-held share capital, such as Capgemini SE, the AFEP-MEDEF Code recommends that at least one-half of Board members should be independent.
